items.title: Garrett Wilson: In the NFL's concussion protocol
items.text:
Wilson, who is in the NFL's concussion protocol, is considered day-to-day,  Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Emeka Egbuka: Works on the side Wednesday
items.text:
Egbuka (foot) was spotted running on the side with a trainer Wednesday, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

items.title: Jeremy McNichols: Done for season with foot injury
items.text:
McNichols, who suffered a foot injury Sunday against the Eagles that may require surgery, is out for the season, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Deshaun Watson: May not clear concussion protocol in time
items.text:
Mary Kay Cabot of the Cleveland Plain Dealer suggests that Watson may have difficulty clearing the NFL's concussion protocol ahead of Sunday's game against the Saints.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jordyn Tyson: Returning to practice Wednesday
items.text:
Tyson (hamstring) is slated to resume practicing with the Saints on Wednesday, Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football reports.
